candidates.name: Systemic Lupus Erythematosus
support_spans: A 22-year-old woman with a history of systemic lupus erythematosus
Antinuclear antibody titer: 1:1280 (speckled pattern)
Positive anti-Smith, antiribonucleoprotein, and SSA/anti-Ro antibodies
candidates.why: The patient has a history of systemic lupus erythematosus and presents with symptoms and laboratory findings consistent with the disease.

candidates.name: Acute Cutaneous Lupus Erythematosus
support_spans: photo-induced flare of acute cutaneous lupus erythematosus (ACLE)
candidates.why: The patient was hospitalized for a photo-induced flare of acute cutaneous lupus erythematosus (ACLE) six days prior to this admission.

candidates.name: Stevens-Johnson Syndrome
support_spans: Numerous flat and raised 2-zoned atypical targets with dusky centers on the forearms, abdomen, back, thighs, legs, palms and soles
Worsening, exquisitely tender rash with several blisters across right arm
candidates.why: The patient presents with target lesions and bullae, which are characteristic of Stevens-Johnson Syndrome.
